description: Construction, steel structures and installation services in Puntarenas, Costa Rica: commercial and industrial projects across the Central Pacific.
ogTitle: Construction Services in Puntarenas | MA Soluciones Integrales
h1: Construction Services in Puntarenas and the Central Pacific
lead: We deliver commercial and industrial projects in the provincial capital of Puntarenas — warehouses, steel structures and installations — with scheduled visits from Jacó.

faqs.q: Do you build industrial warehouses in Puntarenas?
faqs.a: Yes. We design, fabricate and assemble steel structures for warehouses, galeras and workshops in Puntarenas, and build them turnkey from foundations to roofing.

faqs.q: How do you coordinate work so far from Jacó?
faqs.a: We maintain a regular schedule of site visits to Puntarenas and keep permanent supervision on active projects, so distance never affects quality or timelines.

faqs.q: What warranty do commercial projects include?
faqs.a: All work is guaranteed from 3 months for repairs to 24 months for major works, with certified materials and structural steel suited to the coastal environment.
